initialize.instructions:
Purpose: drives a live CS2 Hammer session (the map editor) and the workshop tools (ModelDoc models, the particle editor, soundevents) through an in-process bridge, and play-tests the map you compiled in the tools engine. It is not a general game client and not an offline file editor.

First call: session_status. It shows liveness, the active document, unsaved edits, the addon and `next`. With no document open: an addon with no map -> new_map; an addon with maps -> open_map. A blocked or dead bridge means Hammer is not ready: tell the user, do not retry in a loop.

Intent: if the user asks a question, answer it with read-only tools (annotations carry readOnlyHint) and change nothing. Call a mutating tool only when asked to change something.

Traps:
- Nothing auto-saves. save_map is the only writer; compile_map refuses UnsavedChanges until you save.
- Compiles are jobs. compile_map {waitMs:30000} starts and waits; repeat compile_map {jobId, waitMs:30000} while done is false. Never busy-poll.
- new_map's template already has meshes and spawns: remove them (delete_nodes, or new_map clear) or reuse them.
- Document reads vs game reads: get_entity, find_entities, get_scene_info read the Hammer document (source live) or the saved file (source saved); entity_find, game_state, game_rules read the running game.
- To see the map use look (framed views of an entity, point, box or the whole map; it moves no camera). Describe what the images show before judging.
- run_map loads the COMPILED map (unsaved edits are not in it). The player starts dead on team 0: use run_map {team:"ct"} or "t" to spawn alive.
- logic_auto OnMapSpawn fires at map load, not at round start. To act when play begins use a logic_eventlistener on round_freeze_end. Freeze time blocks movement (game_rules shows it).
- BridgeBusy: another call holds the bridge. Wait for it; do not retry in a loop.
- Errors: read next, useInstead, didYouMean, retrySafe (false = it may have run: check state before repeating). Switch on the error type, not the code. NotImplemented with data.missing: the bridge lacks that method; nothing was sent.
- ModelDoc and particles: edit the .vmdl/.vpcf on disk (model_edit, particle_edit), then model_reload/particle_reload; compile with model_compile/particle_compile (each waits for its result).

For a whole task (a blockout, the edit-compile-test loop, a script, particles, a release) read the matching playbook first: get_playbook {name}, or the MCP prompt of the same name.

Never step outside the tools: if a task needs something no tool does, tell the user and stop. Do not write scripts or reach the bridge another way.

Done means: saved, compiled with 0 failed, loaded with run_map, the requested behaviour checked live with play_test or entity_find, and report_ready passes (or you explain every non-pass). Report with that evidence.

tools.name: session_status
tools.description: Bridge/session status: build, liveness (mainThreadAgeMs), capabilities, active document + host path, unsaved bridge edits, jobs. Never raises.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create entities in one undo group (never saves). Keyvalues are checked against the FGD; an unknown class, a `classname` key or a strict FGD issue refuses with nothing sent. An unknown soundevent name is refused unless allowUnknownSoundEvent.

keyValues.description: max 32 keys, values max 511 bytes; not classname/origin/angles/scales

strict.description: FGD errors refuse instead of warn

undoLabel.description: echoed only; the bridge labels the group itself

tools.name: undo_last
tools.description: Undo one MCP-created undo group. Keyvalue changes are not always reverted; check the result notes. Refuses a user group unless acceptUserEdits.

acceptUserEdits.description: allow undoing a group not created by this server

tools.name: save_map
tools.description: Save the live map to its path (the only tool that writes the .vmap). Refuses a read-only file. Check saved:true.

tools.name: reload_map
tools.description: Reload the live map from disk, discarding unsaved edits and the undo history. Refuses an untitled document, and a dirty one unless force.

tools.name: run_map
tools.description: Load the COMPILED map in the tools session's engine and wait for its load signal. Not for: compiling (compile_map first; a .vpk older than the .vmap is staleCompile). An already-mounted map is unmounted first. path (maps/<x>.vmap) or the active document; unsaved edits are not included. gameType/gameMode are posted first (defuse: 0/1). unload:true only unmounts. state ok|failed|timeout|unknown|unconfirmed (a timeout is not an error). One load at a time (EngineBusy). The player starts on team 0 and dead: pass team "ct"|"t" to join and wait until alive (team.skipped: load unconfirmed, no join).

ignoreRunningCompile.description: load even though a compile_map job for this map is running

path.description: maps/<x>.vmap; default the active document. Not with unload

restartIfDead.description: with team: send mp_restartgame 1 if joined but dead (restarts the match score); false never restarts

team.description: join this team and wait until alive (without it the player is on team 0, dead)

timeoutMs.description: load-signal watch, default 60000, max 600000; clamped to the tool budget

unload.description: unmount the current map instead of loading; no-op outside a map

tools.name: open_map
tools.description: Open a .vmap in Hammer. Path must be a canonical maps/... .vmap of the addon that parses as binary v9 (else InvalidMapFile). Already open = existing:true, not an error; if it is in a background tab the reply says active:false (no tool switches tabs).

tools.name: list_entities
tools.description: Entities from the saved .vmap on disk (not unsaved edits; see find_entities).

tools.name: find_entities
tools.description: Find entities by classname/targetname/sphere. source live = Hammer document, saved = .vmap on disk. Not for: the running game (use entity_find).

source.description: default live if a document is open

withKeyvalues.description: saved only: include each entity's keyvalues

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: One entity (keyvalues, I/O connections) by nodeID or targetname. source live = Hammer document (unsaved edits), saved = .vmap on disk.

source.description: default live if a document is open

tools.name: render_view
tools.description: Render the LIVE map (unsaved edits included) from a camera with Hammer's offscreen renderer: PNG under <app>/renders/ plus an inline image (downscaled above 1920x1080; inline:false skips). Shows editor helpers/gizmos/grid (hideToolMaterials hides trigger/clip/tools volumes). Not for: the compiled game world (render_world). Camera: none = current 3D viewport; origin+angles; origin+lookAt; or lookAt alone to orbit (distance/pitch/yaw). angles [pitch,yaw,roll] degrees, pitch>0 looks down, yaw 0 = +X, 90 = +Y; fov is HORIZONTAL degrees.

tools.name: render_world
tools.description: Render the map loaded in the ENGINE (compiled .vpk: game lighting, sky, entities, no editor helpers) from a required camera, without Hammer. Not for: the live editor view (render_view). Camera: origin+angles, origin+lookAt, or lookAt alone to orbit (distance/pitch/yaw). angles [pitch,yaw,roll] degrees, pitch>0 looks down, yaw 0 = +X; fov is HORIZONTAL degrees. Up to 8192 px per side and 33554432 pixels, independent of the window; image block inline by default only up to 1920x1080 (inline:true forces, false refuses). No map loaded renders a black empty scene (blank note).

tools.name: list_meshes
tools.description: List mesh (brush) nodes of a .vmap: nodeID, origin, bounds, vertex/face counts, materials. Reads the SAVED file (reports staleRead if unsaved edits). Filter with within={min,max} (bounds overlap).

path.description: SAVED .vmap path (addon-relative or absolute); omitted = active document

within.description: meshes whose bounds overlap this box

tools.name: get_mesh
tools.description: Full geometry of one mesh by nodeID: WORLD vertices, faces (counter-clockwise loops), faceMaterials, faceInfo (centre/normal), bounds. Without `path` reads the live document (source "live", unsaved edits included; face order matches the mesh edit tools), else the saved file. A very large live mesh is refused with MeshTooLarge: save_map and retry.

path.description: SAVED .vmap path (addon-relative or absolute); omitted = active document

tools.name: create_mesh
tools.description: Create a mesh in the LIVE map from WORLD-space vertices and faces (vertex-index loops). orientOutward=true auto-fixes the winding of a closed convex solid. Undoable; not saved (save_map).

faceMaterials.description: material path or null (= base material) per face

faces.description: vertex-index loops, counter-clockwise seen from the visible side

orientOutward.description: flip faces pointing at the centroid (closed convex solid)

tools.name: create_block
tools.description: Create a box, wedge (ramp) or cylinder mesh in the LIVE map. box/wedge: min,max; wedge reaches full height at riseToward; cylinder: center (bottom centre), radius, height, sides. top/bottom/sideMaterial override material per face by normal z. Undoable; not saved.

tools.name: set_mesh_geometry
tools.description: Replace ALL polygons of a LIVE mesh (nodeID) with new WORLD-space vertices and faces. The node keeps its id. Undoable; not saved.

faceMaterials.description: material path or null (= base material) per face

faces.description: vertex-index loops, counter-clockwise seen from the visible side

tools.name: transform_mesh
tools.description: Translate, yaw-rotate (degrees about the pivot) and/or scale a LIVE mesh (nodeID). Works from the geometry this server wrote this session, else the SAVED .vmap (refused while the live document is dirty: save_map first); `geometrySource` says which. An odd number of negative scale axes mirrors the mesh. Undoable; not saved.

scale.description: uniform factor or [sx, sy, sz]; zero refused

tools.name: move_mesh_vertices
tools.description: Offset vertices (indices from get_mesh) of a LIVE mesh by [dx, dy, dz], e.g. to make a slope. Faces must stay planar; a move that flattens a face is refused. Geometry source as transform_mesh (own writes, else saved .vmap; dirty document refused). Undoable; not saved.

tools.name: extrude_mesh_face
tools.description: Push one face (index from get_mesh) of a LIVE mesh out along its normal by `distance` (negative = recess), adding side quads. Geometry source as transform_mesh. Undoable; not saved.

tools.name: delete_mesh_faces
tools.description: Remove faces (indices from get_mesh) of a LIVE mesh; remaining indices are renumbered, so call get_mesh again. Not for: removing the whole mesh (delete_nodes). Geometry source as transform_mesh. Undoable; not saved.

tools.name: set_mesh_material
tools.description: Assign a material to a LIVE mesh's faces (all faces if `faces` omitted). With `faces` the mesh is rebuilt from geometry this server wrote this session (live geometry can't be read), so use it on meshes created or rewritten here. Undoable; not saved.

faces.description: face indices from get_mesh; omit for all

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete meshes/entities/groups by nodeID in the live document (one undo group, undo_last restores; never saves).

nodeIDs.description: unique node ids; world cannot be deleted

tools.name: compile_map
tools.description: Compile a Hammer map headless; starts a background job ({jobId, state}). Wait with waitMs (here, or compile_map {jobId, waitMs:30000}) until done:true; success only if state is ok (running|ok|failed|timeout|cancelled; failLines/logTail say why not). {jobId, cancel:true} ends it. path: maps/<x>.vmap, default the active document. mode (exclusive with stages): "full" (default), "novis" (all but VIS, fast), "nav" (-nav only). stages: subset of world, phys, vis, bakelighting, nav; without world it builds on the existing .vpk. UnsavedChanges if the document is unsaved (save_map first); EngineBusy if the engine is in this map (run_map {unload:true}) or another compile runs.

cancel.description: with jobId: end the job instead of polling

jobId.description: poll this job instead of starting one (no path/mode/stages)

mode.description: full: all stages; nav: -nav only (needs .vpk); novis: all but VIS

stages.description: stage subset; without world needs the existing .vpk. Exclusive with mode

waitMs.description: wait for the job up to this long (default 30000, 0 = answer now); reply has done; repeat while done is false

tools.name: set_entity_keyvalues
tools.description: Set keyvalues on an existing entity by nodeID (live, not saved; returns previous values). Values are checked against the FGD; an unknown sound or model name is refused unless force.

force.description: skip the model/soundevent name checks (warning only)

keyValues.description: max 32 keys, values max 511 bytes; not classname/origin/angles/scales

strict.description: FGD errors refuse instead of warn; unchanged values are exempt

tools.name: list_entity_classes
tools.description: Entity classes from the game's FGD files (filter by substring/kind/tag). logic_auto, logic_eventlistener, func_movelinear carry a playNote on round-start timing.

tag.description: FGD tags() helper argument, e.g. Sound, PropStatic, Logic

tools.name: get_entity_class
tools.description: One entity class from the FGD: resolved keyvalues (type, default, choices, flags), inputs, outputs, bases. playNote (round-start timing: what fires at load vs when play begins) present for logic_auto, logic_eventlistener, func_movelinear.

includeBases.description: false = only what the class itself declares

tools.name: get_scene_info
tools.description: Overview of the map: entity counts per class, mesh count, bounds, spawns, and the first `limit` entities whose classname/targetname contains `query`. Start here; find_entities/get_entity/list_meshes for detail. source live = Hammer document, saved = .vmap on disk.

source.description: default live if a document is open

tools.name: get_entity_live
tools.description: Deprecated: use `get_entity` {"source":"live"}.

tools.name: find_entities_live
tools.description: Deprecated: use `find_entities` {"source":"live"}.

tools.name: model_status
tools.description: ModelDoc editor status: whether modeldoc_editor.dll is loaded, missing capabilities, the active document (+ host path, inAddon) and a launch/open hint. Never errors.

tools.name: model_read
tools.description: Read a .vmdl from disk: one node subtree as JSON (_class, name, attrs, children). Path: host, Z:\app\..., or csgo_addons/<addon>/models/x.vmdl.

tools.name: model_list_nodes
tools.description: Flat node list of a .vmdl on disk (path /i/j, _class, name, childCount, attrKeys), filterable by class/name.

tools.name: model_edit
tools.description: Edit a .vmdl in the active addon: ops add_node/remove_node/move_node/set_attr/remove_attr, all-or-nothing, validated, backup + atomic write. Does not touch the editor: model_reload afterwards.

tools.name: model_create
tools.description: Create a new .vmdl in the active addon from a template (static_prop, skeletal). Refuses an existing file unless overwrite.

tools.name: model_compile
tools.description: Compile a .vmdl to .vmdl_c. route resourcecompiler (default; works for new files) or editor (needs hasAsset; refuses a dirty document unless saveFirst). ok = .vmdl_c updated.

tools.name: model_open
tools.description: Open a .vmdl of the active addon in the running ModelDoc. Refuses while the live document is dirty unless force.

tools.name: model_reload
tools.description: Reload the active ModelDoc document from disk (after model_edit); discards editor undo history. Refuses while dirty unless force.

tools.name: model_save
tools.description: Save the active ModelDoc document to its own path (never Save As: refuses untitled documents and files outside the addon).

tools.name: model_node_types
tools.description: Every ModelDoc node class name (_class) the running editor knows, sorted; writeSnapshot stores them under hammer-mcp/research/.

tools.name: model_render
tools.description: Render ModelDoc's main 3D viewport to a PNG under <app>/renders/ and attach it as an image (downscaled above 1920x1080). Needs an open .vmdl tab in the running ModelDoc. Uses the viewport's own camera.

tools.name: particle_read
tools.description: Read a .vpcf from disk: the kv3 header, root non-array fields, per-array entry counts; function:"m_Operators/2" returns that entry's fields. Path: host, Z:\app\..., or csgo_addons/<addon>/particles/x.vpcf.

tools.name: particle_list
tools.description: Flat list of a .vpcf's function entries from disk (array, type, index, class, fieldKeys), filterable by array and class; counts gives entries per array.

tools.name: particle_validate
tools.description: Validate a .vpcf on disk against the particle schema snapshot (structure, classes, fields); returns ok, errors, warnings. No usable snapshot is SchemaUnavailable, never ok:true.

tools.name: particle_edit
tools.description: Edit a .vpcf in the active addon: ops add_function/remove_function/move_function/set_field/remove_field/set_root_field/remove_root_field/add_child/remove_child/add_variable/remove_variable, all-or-nothing, schema-checked (skipSchema skips only that), backup + atomic write. Does not touch the editor: particle_reload afterwards.

tools.name: particle_create
tools.description: Create a new .vpcf in the active addon from the minimal template (maxParticles, renderer). Refuses an existing file unless overwrite.

tools.name: particle_compile
tools.description: Compile a .vpcf (or a folder; recursive) to .vpcf_c with resourcecompiler. children (default true) also compiles m_ChildRef files, children first; stock/external children are reported, not compiled. ok only if every file is.

force.description: recompile even when the compiler thinks the output is current

path.description: a .vpcf or folder of the active addon: addon-relative `particles/x.vpcf`

tools.name: particle_status
tools.description: Particle editor (pet) status: whether pet.dll is loaded, missing capabilities, the active .vpcf document (+ host path, inAddon) and a launch/load hint. Never errors.

tools.name: particle_types
tools.description: Every particle function class the running pet registers, grouped by array. writeSnapshot stores the full schema snapshot under hammer-mcp/research/.

tools.name: particle_schema
tools.description: Schema (bases, flattened fields, metadata) of one particle class, from the running pet if available, else the local snapshot.

tools.name: particle_load
tools.description: Load the particle editor tool into the running tools session and wait for pet.dll to verify. One shot: loaded:false means a modal may be up (restart the session).

tools.name: particle_open
tools.description: Open a .vpcf of the active addon in the running pet. Refuses while the live document is dirty unless force.

tools.name: particle_reload
tools.description: Reload the active pet document from disk after a file edit. A malformed file would crash pet, so it is validated first and nothing is sent if invalid. Refuses while dirty unless force.

tools.name: particle_save
tools.description: Save the active pet document to its own path (never Save As: refuses untitled documents and files outside the addon). force re-saves a clean document in pet's own form.

force.description: re-save a clean document too (pet re-serializes it)

tools.name: particle_live_read
tools.description: Read the live pet document as pet serialized it: path, dirty/canUndo/canRedo, kv3 header, root non-array fields, per-array entry counts; function:"m_Operators/2" returns that entry.

tools.name: particle_live_edit
tools.description: Edit the live pet document in-editor with undo: ops add_function/remove_function/move_function/set_field/remove_field/set_root_field/remove_root_field/add_child/remove_child/add_variable/remove_variable, all-or-nothing, schema-checked (skipSchema skips only that). The document is dirty afterwards: particle_save, or force on reload/open.

allowObsolete.description: obsolete classes warn instead of error (default true)

ops.description: applied in order (the particle_edit op set)

tools.name: particle_undo
tools.description: Undo the last live pet edit (same history as the editor's Ctrl+Z). Nothing to undo is a retry-safe error.

tools.name: particle_redo
tools.description: Redo the last undone live pet edit. Nothing to redo is a retry-safe error.

tools.name: particle_render
tools.description: Render the particle editor's preview viewport to a PNG under <app>/renders/ and attach it as an image (downscaled above 1920x1080). Uses pet's own preview camera; no document needed.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List .vmdl models in the game VPKs and the current addon. Use an entry's `model` value verbatim as a prop's `model` keyvalue.

query.description: case-insensitive substring; '*' or '?' makes it a glob

tools.name: find_assets
tools.description: Find assets in the addon and the game paks by kind: material, model, particle, sound (.vsnd), texture. Hits: `path` (use verbatim), `source` (addon|content=uncompiled source|csgo|core), `compiled`; materials add `renders`: ok | missing_textures (+missingTextures, renders magenta) | unknown (+reason). Sorted by path; limit default 25; pass `nextCursor` as `cursor` for more; `total` counts every match. Prefer renders:ok. Models: get_model_info next.

tools.name: get_model_info
tools.description: Compiled-model facts for placing a prop: render/physics bounds, `facing` (forward +x/-x/+y/-y from front/rear attachments, else unknown + longAxis), `placement` (floorOffset lifts the origin so the model rests on a floor; footprint = x/y box size), skins, bodygroups, sequences, attachments, keyvalues. An uncompiled addon model is refused (ModelNotCompiled). Unknown name: up to 5 suggestions.

include.description: default: sequences, attachments, bodygroups; keyvalues only when named

model.description: any spelling: case, backslashes, .vmdl_c form all accepted

tools.name: list_props
tools.description: Prop entities of a map, from the saved .vmap (source file) or the live document (source live). Kind comes from FGD tags(Prop*).

includeOtherModelEntities.description: include non-prop classes with a model keyvalue (kind other/unknown)

path.description: file source only; addon-relative or host path

source.description: default: file if `path` given, else live

within.description: axis-aligned box on the node origin; max >= min on every axis

tools.name: create_props
tools.description: Place prop entities in one undo group (never saves). Each prop: `kind` static|dynamic|physics, or an explicit prop-tagged FGD `class` (exactly one). `model` is catalog-checked (unknown -> ModelNotFound with suggestions; uncompiled addon model refused unless allowUncompiled). `scales` need a bridge with node.setTransform, else the whole call is refused (BridgeTooOld).

allowUncompiled.description: place props whose model has no compiled .vmdl_c (they do not draw until compiled)

class.description: FGD class carrying a prop tag, else NotAPropClass

snapToFloor.description: lift origin.z by the model floorOffset (get_model_info), scaled by scales.z

tools.name: set_node_transform
tools.description: Move/rotate/scale one live node (entity or mesh) by nodeID. Give at least one of origin/angles/scales; relative=true makes origin/angles deltas and scales factors (needs a readable current value; refused for mesh scales). A moved prop_static changes the editor only until compile_map. Undoable; not saved.

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] degrees; a delta if relative

origin.description: world units; a delta if relative

scales.description: each in (0, 1000]; a factor if relative

tools.name: add_entity_connections
tools.description: Add I/O connections to a live entity by nodeID (one undo group, never saves). Output, target input and prop_static targets are checked against the FGD (force skips the FGD checks, never the prop_static refusal). An entry the bridge could not confirm comes back under `unconfirmed` with outcomeUnknown: read it back, do not retry. Example: trigger_multiple OnStartTouch -> door SetAnimationLooping.

target.description: targetname; `!activator`/`!self`/`!player` or a name not yet in the document are allowed

tools.name: remove_entity_connections
tools.description: Remove live entity I/O connections by nodeID, by `indices` or `match` (output/target/input; safer, indices shift with every edit). One undo group, never saves. `remaining` is what is left; the bridge `count` is the number removed.

indices.description: 0-based, as get_entity lists them; max 512; out-of-range or duplicates refused

match.description: all connections matching these fields; at least one key

tools.name: list_triggers
tools.description: List brush entities (triggers, or every @SolidClass with kind "solid") from the SAVED .vmap (source "file", reports staleRead) or the LIVE document (source "live"). Volumes are the union of the mesh children's bounds. Filter by class, targetname or a `within` box.

path.description: file route only: addon-relative (maps/x.vmap) or absolute .vmap

source.description: default: file when `path` is given, else live

within.description: axis-aligned box matched against the volume (origin if the volume is unknown)

withinMode.description: contains (default) = volume entirely inside; intersects = overlaps

tools.name: create_trigger
tools.description: Create a trigger brush entity in the LIVE map from exactly one volume (`box`, `geometry` or `meshNodeIDs`) and tie it to the new entity. Class must be an FGD @SolidClass. `spawnflags` is the COMPLETE flag set (omit for FGD defaults). `connections` are checked against the FGD before anything is sent. Several undo groups; a failure after the volume exists is PartialFailure (not retry-safe). Never saves.

allowRetie.description: meshNodeIDs only: move meshes that belong to another brush entity

box.description: axis-aligned box; exactly one of box, geometry, meshNodeIDs

max.description: high corner; each side at least 1 unit

connections.description: I/O added to the new entity (as add_entity_connections)

geometry.description: WORLD-space mesh; faces counter-clockwise seen from the visible side

material.description: default: the class's auto_apply_material, else toolstrigger

meshNodeIDs.description: existing live world meshes to tie

retexture.description: also apply `material` to the meshes in `meshNodeIDs`

spawnflags.description: COMPLETE set: labels or bit numbers; unlisted bits OFF; omit = FGD defaults

tools.name: tie_to_entity
tools.description: Tie existing live world meshes to a brush entity: a NEW one (`class`) or an existing one (`entityID`). Already-tied meshes are skipped; `material` retextures the tied meshes. Not for: making a volume from scratch (create_trigger). Never saves.

allowRetie.description: move meshes that belong to another brush entity

class.description: FGD @SolidClass of a new entity; exactly one of class, entityID

entityID.description: existing live brush entity; refuses class/targetname/spawnflags/keyValues

material.description: retexture every tied mesh (default: keep their own)

spawnflags.description: COMPLETE set: labels or bit numbers; unlisted bits OFF; omit = FGD defaults

tools.name: move_to_world
tools.description: Move a brush entity's meshes back under its parent (world/group) and delete the entity. One undo group; never saves.

tools.name: set_trigger_volume
tools.description: Replace a LIVE brush entity's volume with a new `box` or explicit `geometry` (WORLD coordinates), rebuilding one of its tied meshes in place. Several tied meshes: name one with `meshNodeID`. Material defaults to the mesh's own, else the trigger default. One undo group; never saves.

box.description: axis-aligned box; exactly one of box, geometry

max.description: high corner; each side at least 1 unit

min.description: low corner [x, y, z], world space

geometry.description: WORLD-space mesh; faces counter-clockwise seen from the visible side

material.description: default: the mesh's own material, else the trigger default

meshNodeID.description: which tied mesh to rebuild; required if the entity has several

tools.name: list_soundevents
tools.description: List soundevents available to the game and the active addon (game VPKs + addon files; no bridge). Use an entry's `name` verbatim as a sound event keyvalue. Pass `name` for one event's full properties and base chain; the other filters apply to the list only.

file.description: substring of the holding file path

name.description: exact name (case-sensitive): detail route for ONE event; ignores list filters

query.description: case-insensitive substring of the name; '*'/'?' make it a glob

tools.name: edit_soundevents
tools.description: Edit a .vsndevts (default: the addon's soundevents_addon.vsndevts) keeping comments. Args: path?, ops[] of {op:"set",name,properties,merge?} | {op:"remove",name} | {op:"rename",name,to}, dryRun?, createFile?, overwrite? (set replaces an existing event), force? (remove a referenced event), validate?=true. Checked before writing. Compile with compile_soundevents.

tools.name: compile_soundevents
tools.description: Compile a .vsndevts to <file>_c (args: path?, timeoutMs?). Needs a running tools container. ok:false is a result with `errors`. Loaded at the next map load (run_map).

tools.name: create_sound_entities
tools.description: Create sound entities in the LIVE map: `kind` point|sphere|alignedbox|orientedbox|soundscape|soundscape_proxy, or any FGD tags(Sound) `class`. The soundevent name is checked against the index first (a misspelt event is silent at runtime). Engine key spellings are written for you; `schedule` builds a logic_auto (startDelay/stopDelay) and/or a logic_timer (repeatEvery; first fire at repeatInitialDelay + repeatEvery). Needs targetname with schedule/connections; soundscapes refuse schedule. Never saves.

allowUnknownSoundEvent.description: warn instead of refusing unknown soundevents

connections.description: I/O on this entity, checked against its FGD outputs

keyValues.description: other FGD keyvalues; fields above are refused here

kind.description: exactly one of kind and class

radius.description: only if the class has a radius key; soundscapes: integer >= 1 or -1

soundEvent.description: soundevent name; required for point/soundscape kinds

tools.name: drain_sounds
tools.description: Read AND consume the sound events started since the last drain (name, entity, ageMs, decoded params and world position). The ring holds 256 entries: drain promptly and repeat while truncated is true. The local `filter` runs AFTER the drain, so filtered-out events are still consumed (counted in unmatched). `installOnly:true` arms the capture without draining: do it before run_map to catch startOnSpawn events.

within.description: sphere, matched on the decoded position, else origin

resolve.description: default true; false skips the entity lookup (no origin)

tools.name: compile_asset
tools.description: Start the resource compiler on ONE asset of the active addon (vmap vmdl vpcf vsndevts vmat vtex vsnd vsmart vanim vmks); returns {jobId, state:"running"} at once. Poll with job_status {jobId, waitMs} until done:true; success only if state is ok (failLines/logTail say why not). Not for: maps (compile_map adds the dirty/in-game gates and the vpk verdict). path: addon-relative, content-relative (csgo_addons/<addon>/...) or a host/Windows path inside the addon. One compile at a time (EngineBusy names the running job).

flags.description: allowlist: -nav -fshallow -quiet -unbufferedio -noassert -nop4 -f; -maxtextureres N / -threads N as two tokens

game.description: pass -game <gamedir>/csgo; default false for .vmap, else true

path.description: addon-relative, content-relative or absolute path inside the addon

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Status of a compile job (compile_asset or compile_map): state running|ok|failed|cancelled|timeout, elapsedMs, summary, failLines, logTail. jobId c<N> is a compile_map job (same answer as compile_map {jobId}); any other id is a bridge job id, pass it verbatim. No jobId lists both. waitMs waits for the end instead of polling; repeat while done is false; ok only if state is ok.

jobId.description: bridge job id (verbatim) or c<N>; omit to list

waitMs.description: wait for the job up to this long (default 30000, 0 = answer now); reply has done; repeat while done is false

tools.name: job_cancel
tools.description: End a compile job (bridge job id or c<N>) and its whole process tree. Returns the final state; cancelled:false if it had already finished.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: What is selected in the live Hammer document: `mode`, `nodeIDs`, `count`, and in faces mode `faces: [{nodeID, faces:[i]}]` per mesh (indices as get_mesh reports). Other modes report only the count. `truncated:true` = lists cut at 16384 (count is still true). Read-only.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Change the selection in the live Hammer document so the user sees what you work on. `op` replace|add|remove|clear; give exactly one of `nodeIDs` or `faces` ([{nodeID, faces:[i]}], switches to faces mode); clear takes neither. After a mode switch add/remove start empty (`modeChanged`). Not an edit or undo step. `applied` can be below `requested` (locked/hidden nodes; see `notApplied`); unknown nodes or bad face indices refuse with nothing changed. Max 4096 nodeIDs, 65536 face indices.

faces.description: per mesh; not with `nodeIDs` or op clear

tools.name: game_state
tools.description: The local player in the tools session's engine: inGame, map, player {team, alive, origin, velocity, eye angles, flags, active weapon}. samples > 1 re-reads every intervalMs and adds originStepStats (smooth ride = steady steps; jitter = spikes). A dead or team-0 player gets a `hint` with the fix. NoMapLoaded (useInstead run_map) when no map is up. Same as client-mcp's game_state.

intervalMs.description: ms between reads (16 = one frame); 0 = back to back

tools.name: input_set
tools.description: Press/release/tap virtual buttons for the local player and set the view-angle override (usercmd level). press holds until released; tap holds `frames` input frames. Buttons: forward, back, left, right, moveleft, moveright, jump, duck, attack, attack2, use, reload, ... angles [pitch, yaw, roll] is absolute and wins over console setang until null/input_clear. release + tap of the same key in one call re-presses it.

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll]; null clears, absent keeps

tools.name: input_clear
tools.description: Release every virtual button and drop the view-angle override.

tools.name: console_exec
tools.description: Run one console line in the tools session's engine; returns the console.log lines it produced (the last maxLines). Works at the idle level and in a running map; EngineBusy while a level loads. Not for: loading a map (run_map; map/changelevel/connect are refused with useInstead), reading cvars (cvar_get). Session-ending or crashing lines (quit, exit, disconnect, ...) are ConsoleCommandRefused; nothing is sent. In a -tools session `echo` and cvar prints are not logged, so waitFor cannot see them. Limits: line 1023 bytes, `;`-chained command 510, command name 128. The wait ends (`endedBy`) at a waitFor regex match, else the end-of-output marker, else waitMs.

waitFor.description: regex; stop at the first matching output line

tools.name: cvar_get
tools.description: Read console variables: per name {found, value (text), type, default, flags}. devonly cvars read as not found; protected/secret ones (*password*, *token*) are redacted:true. Not for: setting (console_exec `<name> <value>`).

tools.name: input_sequence
tools.description: Run up to 32 input_set steps in order in one call. Each step takes the input_set fields plus turn, and holds holdTicks game ticks (default 1, max 640). Presses persist across steps. Budget about 100 ms per step + ticks/64 s + 1.5 s, checked up front (ToolBudgetExceeded, maxTotalTicks says what fits). Input is cleared at the end and after any error. Not for: holding keys across waits/checks (play_test). Returns steps (startTick, endTick, origin, viewAngles), totals, start, final, inputCleared. NoMapLoaded (useInstead run_map) when no map is up.

steps.description: run in order; each takes the input_set fields

angles.description: [pitch, yaw, roll] override; null clears it, absent leaves it

frames.description: hold length for tap, with tap only

press.description: buttons held until released (forward, back, jump, duck, attack, use, reload, ...)

turn.description: relative to the active override; not with angles

tools.name: play_test
tools.description: Run steps against the local player in the running map; stops at the first failure. Step kinds: input {steps:[as input_sequence]} (keys stay held); wait_ms {ms}; wait_state / expect_state {path, op} on game_state (wait polls, timeoutMs); wait_log {pattern (regex), timeoutMs?, since?: step|start}; wait_entity / expect_entity {class?, name?, index?, path, op} on RUNNING-game entities. op: eq|ne|gt|ge|lt|le|near(+tolerance)|contains|exists, value under that key: {kind:'wait_entity',class:'func_movelinear',path:'origin[0]',gt:1500,timeoutMs:20000}. path: player.alive / player.origin[0]; entity: origin[0], health. Returns passed and endedBy complete|failed|budget (budget = the 45 s call budget ran out: not a pass). Keys wait out freeze (lockWaitMs); still locked then: step fails with movementLocked:true (raise lockWaitMs or lower mp_freezetime). wait_log since:start for a line that can appear during an earlier step. Needs a map (run_map).

keepInput.description: keep keys/view override after a pass

lockWaitMs.description: input: max wait for freeze/intro to end (default 20000 or freezetime+5 s); 0 = none

path.description: game_state field (state kinds) or entity field (entity kinds), e.g. origin[0]

timeoutMs.description: wait kinds, default 5000; cut to the call budget

tools.name: entity_find
tools.description: Find entities in the RUNNING game by class (designer name) and/or name (targetname): entindex, class, name, origin, angles, health, toggleState. Not for: the Hammer document (find_entities). Use it to check where a mover or door is while the map runs. Needs class or name; truncated is true when more matched. NoMapLoaded (useInstead run_map) when no map is running. In play_test use wait_entity / expect_entity.

tools.name: game_rules
tools.description: Round and warmup state of the RUNNING game: warmup, freeze, team intro, restart, round times, win status, bomb planted. Use it to check the freeze period (play_test waits for it before pressing keys). A null field did not resolve (see schemaMissing). NoMapLoaded (useInstead run_map) when no map is running.

tools.name: game_local
tools.description: Deprecated: use `game_state`.

tools.name: set_addon
tools.description: Choose the addon the file tools work in (compile_map, run_map, list_models, soundevents, model_*, particle_*, map file reads). Default: the active Hammer document's addon, else --addon. {addon:"x"} pins x (must exist under content/csgo_addons); {addon:null} follows the document again; no argument reports the selection and available addons. Server state only. A running ModelDoc stays on its addon: model_open refuses while it differs.

addon.description: addon name; null = follow the active document

tools.name: align_texture
tools.description: Set the texture mapping (UV) of a LIVE mesh's faces. mode world = snap to the world grid; face = align to each face's plane; justify = fit to the face (needs `justify`); set = only shift/scale/rotate. shift/scale/rotate apply after world/face/set, not with justify. Answers each face's axisU/axisV [x,y,z,offset] and scale. Undoable; not saved.

rotate.description: degrees added to the current orientation

scale.description: [u, v] world units per texel, absolute

tools.name: apply_layout
tools.description: Build many meshes and entities in the LIVE map from ONE JSON layout: path (a .json inside the project) or layout (inline), exactly one. Format: {"meshes":[{"kind":"block"|"mesh", ...create_block / create_mesh args}], "entities":[create_entities items]}; any item may carry an `id` that the result maps to its nodeID. Everything is validated first (errors list index/id; nothing is sent on any error); dryRun returns counts and bounds only. Max 32 meshes, 64 entities, 4 MiB mesh parameters per call. Each mesh is its own undo group plus one for the entities (result undoGroups = undo_last calls to remove it). A mid-way failure reports what was created. Never saves.

items.description: kind block|mesh plus its create_* args; optional `id`

path.description: a .json layout inside the project (absolute, or relative to the addon / project root)

tools.name: new_map
tools.description: Create a .vmap in the active addon from a template and (default) open it. Use when the addon has no map yet (Hammer loads only with a document open). Not for: opening an existing file (open_map). template: addon_template (default; a ready CS2 map with spawns, bomb sites, buy zones, sky, light) or another .vmap of the addon. Refuses an existing target unless overwrite:true (old file kept as .bak-<seconds>). clear:"gameplay" deletes meshes (toolsskybox too), spawns, buy/bomb zones, worldtext (keeps sky, light, fog); clear:"all" keeps only worldspawn; both need open. Not saved: save_map.

clear.description: delete the template's nodes after opening; default none; needs open

overwrite.description: default false: an existing file is refused

template.description: "addon_template" (default) or a .vmap of the addon, e.g. maps/base.vmap

tools.name: look
tools.description: See the map: framed images of a target from poses it computes (no camera maths). Changes nothing; the Hammer camera is never moved (cameraRestored). target: entity (targetname or nodeID), point [x,y,z], box {min,max} or "map" (saved mesh extents, else entity origins). mode: viewport (no target: the Hammer viewport as is); angles (with target: two corners and top); tour (count views around it); frames (count images of one pose over time; needs a running game, run_map first); player_eye (the player's eye, or pose). Engine renders show the COMPILED map; source editor renders the live document. Describe what you see in writing, then fix what is wrong.

name.description: file stem; each view appends its label

tools.name: report_ready
tools.description: Ship check: runs the checks and answers verdict pass|warn|fail|incomplete, each check pass|warn|fail|skipped with detail and fix. profile map (default): saved, compiled (vpk current), materials (incl. textures), spawns, spawn_in_mover_path, objectives (informational unless mode defuse|hostage). release adds loose_compiled, debug_patterns, no_metamod_load (always skipped), test_cvars. Reads the saved .vmap, the vpk and the addon tree; never saves, compiles or loads. incomplete = a check could not run: not done. Not for: seeing the map (render_world). Next: apply each failing check's fix, then call again.

checks.description: run only these checks (names as in the result)

debugPatterns.description: extra regexes for debug_patterns (added to the built-in list)

map.description: maps/x.vmap, addon-relative; default = active doc, else the addon's only map

mode.description: objectives: defuse needs bomb sites + buy zones, hostage needs hostages + rescue zone; else informational

profile.description: map (default) or release (adds the shipping checks)

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Step-by-step procedure for a whole task, as text (the same as the MCP prompt): blockout_map, iterate_loop, cs_script, particle_set, release. No name lists them. Pass map, script or folder to fill in the calls (else they use the active document). Read the matching one before such a task.
